name: Neobrutalism
summary: Free MIT neobrutalism shadcn/ui components: thick borders, hard shadows, loud type.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~64 documented comps — not a full inventory.
Upstream maintainer announced project no longer actively maintained (GitHub discussion #100, Jul 2025); MIT license remains; site + registry still HTTP 200.
Requires neo styling init (e.g. npx shadcn@latest init https://neobrutalism.dev/r/styling/blue.json) or add styling registry before comps.
Built on shadcn/ui + Base UI + Tailwind v4; some comps have registryDependencies (e.g. toast → nbutton).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://neobrutalism.dev/r/button.json

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button>Click me</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use Neobrutalism free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://www.neobrutalism.dev/docs/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://neobrutalism.dev/r/button.json` after neo styling init (`npx shadcn@latest init https://neobrutalism.dev/r/styling/blue.json` or add styling). Imports land under `@/components/ui/button`. Exports: Button. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui (Base UI). License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekmas/neobrutalism-components/main/LICENSE). Pricing free. Note: upstream announced no longer actively maintained (Jul 2025) but MIT sources + site/registry remain live.
